sourceChecks.note: The exact official page and its embedded Swatch product payload independently validate SO28N100 identity, the 1983 Originals family, bio-sourced case and strap, 34 x 8.75 x 39.2 mm geometry, quartz movement, 3 bar water resistance, and buckle clasp. The visible product data marks the item online but currently unavailable without a price; it does not publish lug width, a watch-only weight, a numerical rate bound, an explicit lume grade, or date status.

Swatch's public exact-reference Shopper Products response exposes an unqualified custom c_weight value of 64. The response supplies no unit or configuration and does not identify the value as full-watch mass without packaging. It therefore cannot be mapped to geometry.weightFullG, particularly while exact product records explicitly report conflicting 18 g and 22 g watch weights.
This source is for SO28N110, not the target SO28N100, and cannot support the target's lug-width fact.

The exact-reference Swiss official-retailer page was independently retrieved with a CHF 70 new-watch offer, add-to-cart path, and stated delivery in two to four weeks. The reviewed snapshot is normalized as a Switzerland authorized-dealer short wait rather than manufacturer inventory.

The official-dealer exact replacement strap ASO28N100 explicitly identifies SO28N100 compatibility, a 17 mm lug width, steel-pin mount, and non-straight attachment. Swatch's official strap guide independently documents its push-out connector-pin replacement mechanism.

Swatch's official strap guide instructs owners to push the connector pin completely out and slide it back through the replacement strap. Combined with the exact ASO28N100 component record, this corroborates a proprietary pinned Swatch interface rather than a conventional spring bar.

The authorized retailer's exact SO28N100 specification reports 22 g without packaging, but a separate exact-reference retailer reports 18 g. Neither value is accepted while the full-watch conflict remains unresolved.

The exact SO28N100 product record reports 18 g, conflicting with the authorized Polish retailer's 22 g full-watch value. The discrepancy is retained instead of selecting the more coverage-favorable number.
The exact SO28N100 authorized-retailer specification explicitly reports no date. A separate exact-reference product record independently reports no date indication.
The exact-reference specification explicitly states that SO28N100 has no date indication, corroborating the separate retailer's categorical no-date field.

Swatch's official technical information explains quartz precision qualitatively but publishes no numerical quartz tolerance applicable to SO28N100. It therefore cannot satisfy the catalogue's accuracy bound.
